semantic_models.name: aco_performance_periods
semantic_models.description: One row per ACO per CMS performance period from the Shared Savings Program financial and quality results. Dollars are totals for the period (PY 2019 has two six-month periods for some ACOs; 2012 starters have an 18 or 21 month first period in PY 2013). Use performance_year to filter years; it covers both PY 2019 periods.

dimensions.name: performance_year_start
dimensions.description: January 1 of the performance year (both PY 2019 periods map to 2019-01-01).

dimensions.name: performance_period_id
dimensions.description: CMS file period id; 2019 and 2019A are the two PY 2019 periods.

dimensions.name: risk_model
dimensions.description: One-Sided (shares savings only) or Two-Sided (also owes losses).

dimensions.name: agreement_type
dimensions.description: Initial, Renewal or Re-entering agreement period (published from PY 2016).

dimensions.name: assignment_type
dimensions.description: Prospective or Retrospective beneficiary assignment (published from PY 2021).

dimensions.name: revenue_category
dimensions.description: High Revenue or Low Revenue ACO (published from PY 2018).

dimensions.name: savings_rate_band
dimensions.description: ACO savings rate band for the period.

dimensions.name: earned_savings_flag
dimensions.description: True when the ACO earned a shared savings payment for the period.

dimensions.name: met_quality_standard_flag
dimensions.description: True when the ACO met the quality performance standard (published from PY 2016).

measures.name: expenditure_dollars
measures.description: Total Parts A and B spending for assigned beneficiaries.

measures.name: savings_dollars
measures.description: Benchmark minus expenditures (negative values are losses).

measures.name: earned_shared_savings_dollars
measures.description: Shared savings payments CMS paid to ACOs.

measures.name: shared_losses_dollars
measures.description: Shared losses two-sided ACOs owed to CMS.

measures.name: assigned_beneficiaries
measures.description: Assigned beneficiaries (summed over periods; an ACO in both PY 2019 periods counts twice).

measures.name: person_years_total
measures.description: Assigned beneficiary person years (annualized by CMS).

measures.name: annualized_expenditure_dollars
measures.description: Per capita expenditure times person years, used to build person-year weighted per capita spending.

measures.name: risk_adjusted_expenditure_dollars
measures.description: Risk normalized per capita expenditure times person years.

measures.name: quality_score_average
measures.description: Simple average of ACO quality scores (0 to 100).

measures.name: reconciliations_earning_savings
measures.expr: case when earned_shared_savings > 0 then 1 else 0 end
measures.description: ACO performance periods with a shared savings payment.

semantic_models.name: tracks
semantic_models.description: Shared Savings Program tracks (risk arrangements) and their maximum sharing rates.

dimensions.name: track_family
dimensions.description: Track 1, Track 1+, Track 2, Track 3, BASIC A and B (one-sided), BASIC C to E (two-sided) or ENHANCED.

dimensions.name: program_era
dimensions.description: Original tracks (2012 to mid 2019) or Pathways to Success (July 2019 on).

dimensions.name: track_risk_model
dimensions.description: Risk model implied by the track.

semantic_models.name: acos
semantic_models.description: One row per ACO (conformed key across the PY 2017 to 2018 identifier change).

dimensions.name: primary_state
dimensions.description: State with the most reported assigned person years in the ACO's latest county file.

dimensions.name: aco_key_method
dimensions.description: How the ACO key was assigned (published id, bridged legacy id, or legacy id only).

dimensions.name: first_performance_year
dimensions.description: First year the ACO was reconciled.

semantic_models.name: performance_periods
semantic_models.description: CMS performance periods with the quality methodology that applied.

dimensions.name: quality_measure_set
dimensions.description: ACO measure set (2013 to 2020) or APM Performance Pathway (2021 to 2024).

dimensions.name: comparability_group
dimensions.description: Quality scores are comparable only within a group.

semantic_models.name: aco_attribution
semantic_models.description: Person years, spending and CMS-HCC risk scores by ACO, period and Medicare enrollment type.

measures.name: enrollment_person_years
measures.description: Person years for the enrollment type (suppressed cells excluded).

measures.name: person_years_with_risk_score
measures.expr: case when risk_score is not null then person_years end
measures.description: Person years where a risk score is published.

semantic_models.name: aco_quality_results
semantic_models.description: One row per ACO, period, quality measure and collection type.

measures.name: measure_rate_average
measures.description: Simple average of reported performance rates.

measures.name: measure_results
measures.description: ACO results expected for the measure (reported or not).

measures.name: measure_results_reported
measures.expr: case when is_reported then 1 else 0 end

metrics.name: total_benchmark
metrics.label: Total benchmark expenditures
metrics.description: Sum of ACO spending targets (benchmarks) in dollars.

metrics.name: total_expenditures
metrics.label: Total expenditures
metrics.description: Sum of Parts A and B spending for assigned beneficiaries in dollars.

metrics.name: total_savings
metrics.label: Total savings (benchmark minus expenditures)
metrics.description: Benchmark minus actual spending, summed over ACOs; ACOs above benchmark subtract.

metrics.name: savings_rate
metrics.label: Savings rate
metrics.description: Total savings divided by total benchmark. Program-level rate weights each ACO by its benchmark.

metrics.name: earned_shared_savings
metrics.label: Earned shared savings payments
metrics.description: Dollars CMS paid ACOs that beat their minimum savings rate and met the quality standard.

metrics.name: shared_losses_owed
metrics.label: Shared losses owed
metrics.description: Dollars two-sided ACOs owed CMS because spending exceeded the benchmark beyond their minimum loss rate.

metrics.name: net_savings_to_medicare
metrics.label: Net savings to Medicare
metrics.description: Total savings minus shared savings payments plus shared losses owed.

metrics.name: assigned_beneficiaries
metrics.label: Assigned beneficiaries
metrics.description: Medicare beneficiaries assigned to ACOs (an ACO in both PY 2019 periods is counted in each).

metrics.name: earned_shared_savings_per_assigned_beneficiary
metrics.label: Earned shared savings per assigned beneficiary
metrics.description: Shared savings payments divided by assigned beneficiaries.

metrics.name: per_capita_expenditure
metrics.label: Per capita expenditure
metrics.description: Person-year weighted annual spending per assigned beneficiary.

metrics.name: risk_adjusted_per_capita_expenditure
metrics.label: Risk-adjusted per capita expenditure
metrics.description: Person-year weighted spending per beneficiary after dividing each enrollment type's spending by its mean CMS-HCC risk score.

metrics.name: mean_quality_score
metrics.label: Mean quality score
metrics.description: Simple average ACO quality score (0 to 100). Compare only within a comparability_group; the method changed in PY 2021 and PY 2023.

metrics.name: aco_count
metrics.label: Number of ACOs
metrics.description: Distinct ACOs reconciled.

metrics.name: share_earning_savings
metrics.label: Share of reconciliations earning shared savings
metrics.description: ACO performance periods with a shared savings payment divided by all ACO performance periods.

metrics.name: mean_risk_score
metrics.label: Mean CMS-HCC risk score
metrics.description: Person-year weighted mean prospective CMS-HCC risk score, by enrollment type if grouped.

metrics.name: quality_reporting_rate
metrics.label: Quality measure reporting rate
metrics.description: Share of expected ACO measure results that have a reported value.

metrics.name: mean_measure_rate
metrics.label: Mean measure performance rate
metrics.description: Simple average of reported performance rates for the selected measures.

metrics.name: person_years
metrics.label: Person years
metrics.description: Assigned beneficiary person years (annualized).

metrics.name: annualized_expenditure
metrics.label: Annualized expenditure (building block)
metrics.description: Per capita expenditure times person years.

metrics.name: risk_adjusted_expenditure
metrics.label: Risk-adjusted annualized expenditure (building block)
metrics.description: Risk normalized per capita expenditure times person years.

metrics.name: reconciliations_count
metrics.label: ACO reconciliations
metrics.description: ACO performance periods reconciled.

metrics.name: reconciliations_earning_savings_count
metrics.label: ACO reconciliations earning shared savings
metrics.description: ACO performance periods with a shared savings payment.

metrics.name: risk_weighted_person_years_sum
metrics.label: Risk weighted person years (building block)
metrics.description: Risk score times person years.

metrics.name: person_years_with_risk_score_sum
metrics.label: Person years with a risk score (building block)
metrics.description: Person years where a risk score is published.

metrics.name: measure_results_count
metrics.label: Expected quality results (building block)
metrics.description: ACO measure results expected (reported or not).

metrics.name: measure_results_reported_count
metrics.label: Reported quality results (building block)
metrics.description: ACO measure results with a reported value.
